notes: Cell 48 (trailing code cell) issues s.multimegasweep([magnet.field],[B_vec],[k_tg.volt,k_bg.volt],[Vtgs,Vbgs], slow_delay=3.0, fast_delay=2.4). B_vec is a two-segment uniform-1/B stitch -- np.hstack of linspace(1/0.70,1/1.25,22)[:-1] and linspace(1/1.25,1/10.0,71), inverted and rounded to 4 dp -- giving 92 ascending rows from 0.70 to 10.0 T (d(1/B)=0.030 below 1.25 T, 0.010 above), hence reported as B_values rather than a uniform quadruple. Density fast axis: np.linspace(3.2, 2.0, 25) in 1e12 cm^-2 at D=0 via calc_gate_voltages with the session's run-5 calibration committed in the same cell (c_tg=2.796e-3, c_bg=2.161e-3, n_offset=-0.0894, D_offset=-0.013), yielding Vtg +0.984 to +0.640 V and Vbg +1.166 to +0.721 V, inside the cell-18 validators. Recorded lock-in channels are sr0.X/P and sr1.X/P; sr1 sensitivity 50 uV is set in the appended cell, while sr1 tau 0.3 s and sr0 sens 0.02 V / tau 0.3 s are inherited from the close_out(restore=state0) readback in cell 44, as is nplci=1 on both Keithleys (re-asserted in cell 48's preconditions). Drive is sr1 at 1.0 V through the device card's 100 MOhm bias resistor; the stated ETA in the cell-47 markdown is about 3 h 15 m.
